title: Studio of Painted Horror
description: A surreal painted hallway with purple walls features large canvases of women's faces with blue and red paint dripping from their mouths and eyes. The wooden parquet floor is covered in hyper-realistic painted bodies, blood, and art supplies, creating an optical illusion. A door marked STUDIO, an elevator, and a spiral staircase are visible in the background.
prompt: A surreal and disturbing art studio hallway with deep purple walls. Large canvases lean against the walls showing women's faces with blue paint violently dripping from their mouths and red from their eyes. The wooden herringbone floor is entirely painted with hyperrealistic images of dead or bleeding women, scattered art supplies, and blood. A wooden door labeled STUDIO, an elevator, and a black spiral staircase are visible in the background, creating a nightmarish optical illusion.
